plan: Parse recipe, request, and catalog into internal structures without mutating inputs.
Scale all ingredient quantities and yield by target_yield / original_yield.

Apply catalog substitutions iteratively: for each ingredient, find best matching choice (lowest priority, then catalog order) whose 'for' matches ingredient id or name; apply result changes (quantity_factor, unit, preparation, equipment, wording_changes, additional ingredients).
After each substitution, check if any ingredient (including additional) is excluded; if so, record reason and mark impossible.
Detect substitution cycles by tracking applied ingredient ids; if an ingredient is revisited, record cycle reason.
Check equipment availability: after all substitutions, ensure all equipment in recipe is in available_equipment; if not, record reason.
If impossible, collect all independent reasons (no substitution, equipment unavailable, cycle) and return with recipe null.
If possible, apply wording changes to instruction strings, sort equipment, and return adapted recipe with choices and warnings.
Implement print_original to return authored_text exactly.
mechanisms: Deep copy recipe and request to avoid mutation.
Use Fraction for all quantity arithmetic.
Maintain a list of applied choices and a set of visited ingredient ids for cycle detection.
Use a priority queue or sorted list for catalog choices per ingredient.
Track warnings for substitutions that change wording or equipment.
Collect reasons in a set to ensure uniqueness and sort at end.
